**Download `PulseSetup` below and run it** to install Pulse (no administrator password needed).
Works on any 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 PC.

## Pulse 1.1

**Accounts**
- **Forgot your password?** Press it when signing in: Pulse emails you a 6-digit code, and you choose a new password.
- Sign in with your username or your email address.
- New accounts need an email address. It's only used for password resets and is never shown to anyone. Accounts made before this are asked to add one.
- Change your email in Settings → Account.

**Fixes**
- Typing a wrong password when changing your password or deleting your account no longer signs you out.

Everything new in 1.0 is in the [1.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/mercy123xz/Pulse/releases/tag/v1.0.0).
